mods.name: Fatfingert
mods.description: Misinput insurance for your hotbar. Reserve the offhand and hotbar slots for specific items so a fat-fingered key press or click can't wreck your loadout. Client-side only, no automation.

releases.notes:
Fatfingert **3.1.0** for **Minecraft 26.2** (Fabric, client-side).

This is the `main` line — the branch the mod is primarily developed on.

| | |
|---|---|
| Minecraft | 26.2 |
| Java | 25 |
| Fabric Loader | 0.19.3 |
| Fabric API | 0.158.0+26.2 (required) |
| Mod Menu | 20.0.1 (optional) |

**Install:** drop `fatfingert-3.1.0+26.2.jar` into `.minecraft/mods` alongside Fabric API, replacing 3.0.1. Your config carries over; see *Upgrading from 3.0.x* below.

### What's new

- **Preset menu.** Click the preset name to open a list of all your presets, showing how many slots each one guards. Pick one to switch to it. **Right-click** the name to rename it. The `‹` / `›` arrows still step through presets one at a time.
- **The On/Off switch is gone.** Fatfingert is always on. To turn it off, switch to the built-in **None** preset (or any preset with nothing guarded). You can't add items to None, rename it, or delete it, so it's always there. The "Toggle Fatfingert On/Off" hotkey is gone too. Use *Next/Previous Preset* to get to None instead.
- **Warnings switch.** The red "⚠ Slot 1 only takes …" message above your hotbar now has its own **Warnings** switch, and it's **off by default**. It also has a *Toggle Block Warnings* hotkey.
- **Inventory Button** moved to the top-right of the panel, where On/Off used to be. Warnings is in its old place.

### Upgrading from 3.0.x

- If Fatfingert was switched **off**, you start on the None preset, so it doesn't start guarding again after the update.
- Warnings start **off**. Turn the Warnings switch on if you want them back.
- Any rules you'd added to the old "none" preset move to a new preset called **Custom** instead of being lost. Custom stays selected if "none" was.
- A key bound to the old On/Off hotkey no longer does anything.

The config migration was checked outside the game by loading 3.0.x-style configs through the new loader.

> **Not yet launched in-game.** This jar is compile-verified only; it has not been run in an actual Minecraft client. Please report anything that misbehaves.

Other Minecraft versions: [26.1.2](https://github.com/secretnarwhal/Fatfingert/releases/tag/v3.0.0%2B26.1.2) · [1.21.11](https://github.com/secretnarwhal/Fatfingert/releases/tag/v3.1.0%2B1.21.11) · [1.21–1.21.1](https://github.com/secretnarwhal/Fatfingert/releases/tag/v3.0.0%2B1.21.1)

From the [`1.21.11`](https://github.com/secretnarwhal/Fatfingert/tree/1.21.11) branch. Same features as [3.1.0 for 26.2](https://github.com/secretnarwhal/Fatfingert/releases/tag/v3.1.0%2B26.2).

### Port notes

Only API names and rendering differ from `main`. 1.21.11 draws a screen in one pass, so the panel draws its own labels and the preset menu after `super.render()`. The menu then starts a new layer with `nextStratum()` so it covers the widgets underneath, as on 26.2.

Built against real Minecraft 1.21.11. The click mixin still remaps to `method_2906` on `net/minecraft/class_636` (`MultiPlayerGameMode.handleInventoryMouseClick`). The new overrides remap to `AbstractWidget.isValidClickButton` (`method_25351`, for right-click to rename) and `Screen.mouseClicked` (`method_25402`, for the preset menu). Fatfingert **3.0.1** for **Minecraft 26.2** (Fabric, client-side).

This is the `main` line — the branch the mod is primarily developed on.

| | |
|---|---|
| Minecraft | 26.2 |
| Java | 25 |
| Fabric Loader | 0.19.3 |
| Fabric API | 0.158.0+26.2 (required) |
| Mod Menu | 20.0.1 (optional) |

**Install:** drop `fatfingert-3.0.1+26.2.jar` into `.minecraft/mods` alongside Fabric API, replacing 3.0.0. Your config carries over.

### What's new

- **Keybinds.** A new **Keybinds** button next to Done lists a hotkey for every control that works outside the menu: turn Fatfingert on/off, open the menu, show/hide the inventory button, toggle Lock Contents, toggle Strict Shift, and next/previous preset. They're all unbound by default and also appear under *Options → Controls → Fatfingert*. A "Toggle Fatfingert" key you bound on 3.0.0 still works.
- **Hide the inventory button.** A new **Inventory Button** switch. While it's hidden, open the menu with its hotkey or through Mod Menu.
- The master switch now reads **On / Off** instead of a fixed "Armed".
- **Fixed:** the labels on **Done** and **+ Add Item** looked doubled (dark text with a dark drop shadow).

### Guarding changes

The gate now only guards what goes **into** a slot.

- A wrong item can always be taken **out** of a guarded slot, whether by click, double-click, number key, F, Q or shift-click. Lock Contents now only holds on to items the slot actually allows.
- **Strict Shift** follows the path a shift-click really takes, instead of blocking whenever any guarded hotbar slot is empty. Shift-clicking into a chest or taking armor off is no longer blocked; it only steps in when the item would land in a guarded slot that doesn't accept it. In furnaces, crafting tables and similar menus it still errs on the cautious side, because it can't tell exactly where the item will go.

> **Not yet launched in-game.** This jar is compile-verified only; it has not been run in an actual Minecraft client. Please report anything that misbehaves.

releases.notes:
> **Superseded by [3.0.1](https://github.com/secretnarwhal/Fatfingert/releases/tag/v3.0.1%2B26.2)**, which adds keybinds and an inventory-button toggle, and lets a wrong item always be taken out of a guarded slot.

Fatfingert **3.0.0** for **Minecraft 26.2** (Fabric, client-side).

This is the `main` line — the branch the mod is primarily developed on.

| | |
|---|---|
| Minecraft | 26.2 |
| Java | 25 |
| Fabric Loader | 0.19.3 |
| Fabric API | 0.158.0+26.2 (required) |
| Mod Menu | 20.0.1 (optional) |

Reserve your offhand and hotbar slots for specific items so a mistimed key press or click can't wreck your loadout. Client-side only — it does not need to be on the server, and it only ever *cancels* an input you already made. No automation.

**Install:** drop `fatfingert-3.0.0+26.2.jar` into `.minecraft/mods` alongside Fabric API.

### What changed from 26.1.2

Exactly one API break: **screen management moved off `Minecraft` and onto `Minecraft.gui`.**

| 26.1.2 | 26.2 |
|---|---|
| `minecraft.setScreen(screen)` | `minecraft.gui.setScreen(screen)` |
| `minecraft.screen` (field) | `minecraft.gui.screen()` (accessor) |

`Minecraft` does still expose a `setScreenAndShow(Screen)`, and it is *not* the drop-in replacement — its bytecode is `gui.setScreen(screen)` followed by `renderFrame(false)`, i.e. it forces an immediate extra frame. That is what vanilla wants for loading and progress screens, not for opening a config panel. The plain swap is `gui.setScreen`, which is what vanilla's own `Screen.onClose()` now calls (`minecraft.gui.setScreen(null)`).

Nothing else moved, so there are no behavioural changes in this release - same feature set as 26.1.2.

Dependency bumps: Fabric API `0.154.0+26.1.2` → `0.158.0+26.2`, Mod Menu `18.0.0` → `20.0.1` (20.0.x is the 26.2 line; 19.0.0-alpha.1 only ever targeted a 26.2 snapshot). Fabric Loader stays at `0.19.3`.

The 26.1.2 line is preserved on the [`26.1`](https://github.com/secretnarwhal/Fatfingert/tree/26.1) branch.
